items.q: then his valet, Jim Lowe, comes over and says, “Hey, the old man wants to see you, and bring that little flute.”

ctx.x: Well did you make a weekly salary?

Yeah it depended, night by night, a certain amount. I think it was about like 75 bucks, and this was like ’73 you know, so a full week was like $450 or something like that, is that right? They took the hotel out of it, the hotels were like 15 dollars. So it was like nothing. The funny thing is though the way they paid — Paul Gonsalves probably ended up being the highest paid musician in all of history, because his bar bills — we always stayed at hotels that had restaurants and bars. And his bar bills were legend.…
Did Duke copy his own music?
